title: docs(sso): the SSO page does not describe mapping an identity provider's groups to permission sets
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKZzp4DLtqiCkZZRM

Filing gate: ② a follow-up the seat's ACCEPT of PR #31657 (#30967 item 3) names, from the dev's open question 4. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:server` (the plugin-auth SSO surface). File: `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `sso.mdx group mapping` → #30967 only.
reach: every operator configuring SSO who wants IdP groups to grant permission sets.
class: b · type: Documentation
Grade: left to triage (seat suggests p3).

## 维护者速读

#30967 第 3 项（PR #31657）之后，SSO 登录会按身份提供方的组，授予 `sys_idp_group_mapping` 映射到的普通权限集。SSO 文档页还没写这件事：怎样在提供方的 `mapping.extraFields.groups` 里配置组声明，怎样用 `providerId` 保存映射，以及组声明缺失时会撤回该提供方先前授予的权限集。

## What is missing (read in the tree at the seat's ACCEPT)

- `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` names no group mapping.
- The behaviour an operator needs, as PR #31657's changeset states it: the groups claim is configured in the provider's own `mapping.extraFields.groups`; a mapping is saved through `POST /admin/scim/set-group-mapping` with `providerId` (exactly one of `connectionId` / `providerId`); only ordinary permission sets inside the provider's organization are granted; grants follow the IdP at every sign-in, and an absent claim removes that provider's own earlier grants; a failure is logged and never fails the sign-in.

## Expected

- A short section on the SSO page with the above, linking the SCIM page's group-mapping section (one model, two sources).

Related: #30967 / PR #31657, #30959 / ADR-0152.
